navtitle.two: Our common care from day one

intro: Dear colleagues, dear friends and collaborators,

symposiumPage.p1:
It is my exceptional honor on behalf of the
Pediatric Association for Gastroenterology, Hepatology, Nutrition, Clinical Immunology and Allergology to invite you to the Congress with international participation organized by PAGNIA and ZNRM titled “Multidisciplinary approach for healthy childhood - our common care from day one” which will be held from May 8th to 10th, 2026 at Hotel Drim in Struga.
symposiumPage.p2: The creation of this pediatric association emerged from everyday clinical practice and the connection of important mechanisms of disease occurrence and their treatment.
symposiumPage.l1: - contribution to pharmacotherapy management of acute and chronic conditions, rational drug use and prevention of adverse effects.
symposiumPage.l2: - support in optimization of therapeutic strategies, management of polypharmacy, individualization of therapy and monitoring of drugs with narrow therapeutic index.
symposiumPage.l3: - part of the holistic approach in treatment and prevention of diseases and the pharmacist's role in health support and improvement of health outcomes.
symposiumPage.p3: Pediatric gastroenterology, hepatology and nutrition are extremely important areas for creating a healthy individual in society. Immune primacy and the importance of the gastrointestinal tract is closely related to clinical immunology and allergology.
symposiumPage.p4: The Congress is intended for residents, pediatricians, subspecialists, dietitians, young doctors, primary care physicians, family medicine doctors, nurses and related branches and specialties whose daily activity is deeply intertwined with them.
symposiumPage.p5: Main topics of the congress are: various diseases from an immunological aspect, gastrointestinal and hepatological diseases, nutrition of healthy and sick children, allergology, latest recommendations in diagnosis and treatment from a large number of specialties, modern diagnostics and therapy, including protocols, personalized medicine and innovations.
symposiumPage.p6: The Congress is a place where colleagues can personally exchange experiences on the latest scientific and professional achievements from various fields.
symposiumPage.p7: The Roman philosopher Seneca said: “It is better to learn something unnecessary than to learn nothing”.
symposiumPage.p8: The pleasure will be greater if we create history together, merging new ideas for an exciting future and unforgettable memories of shared intellectual and social friendship.
symposiumPage.p10: President of the Pediatric Association for Gastroenterology, Hepatology,
symposiumPage.p13: It is with great pleasure, on behalf of
symposiumPage.p14: The Association of Neonatologists of R. Macedonia, the scientific and organizational board, that I announce the holding of the Congress with international participation organized by PAGNIA and ZNRM titled “Multidisciplinary approach for healthy childhood - our common care from day one” which will be held from 08-10.05.2026 at Hotel Drim - Struga.
symposiumPage.p15: Top experts from our country, the region and Europe will take part in the congress, presenting the latest knowledge as well as their professional experiences through a rich scientific program filled with plenary lectures and professional workshops.
symposiumPage.p16: New achievements in the care and treatment of newborns are always a huge challenge for neonatologists, pediatricians, family doctors and all other related specialties who are in any way involved in the care of healthy childhood from day one.
symposiumPage.p17: The Congress will be an opportunity to exchange experiences and ideas, acquire new knowledge, be informed about novelties in therapy and improve one's own capabilities in providing the best health care for newborns.
symposiumPage.p18: Therefore, we expect you to contribute with your presence and constructive discussions to the successful realization of the planned activities, as well as establishing new professional contacts and friendships.
symposiumPage.p21: President of the Association of Neonatologists of R. Macedonia

abstractPage.title: ABSTRACT SUBMISSION

submission.text: Abstract submission is done electronically by sending an email to the following link, using the attached form from the website:

requirements.font: Abstracts should be written in Times New Roman font with 12 font size, with single spacing and in A4 format.
requirements.content: The abstract should contain: title, names and surnames of the authors (underline the presenter), Institution they come from, and the content of the abstract should be min. 200 and max. 300 words with at most 5 keywords.
requirements.structure: Abstracts should be as concise as possible and it is recommended that they be conceived with an introduction and objectives, methodology (if applicable), results and discussion, conclusion and references (at most two cited references, Harvard style)
requirements.language: Abstracts should be written in English and Macedonian.
requirements.example: Attached is an example of a correctly submitted abstract (link to example).

process.typeSelection: When submitting abstracts, the author should choose whether they want an oral or poster presentation.
process.scientificBoardDesc: After reviewing the abstracts, the Scientific Board reserves the right to transfer a certain abstract from oral to poster presentation or vice versa.

presentation.oral: Oral presentations can be in the native language, but presentations MUST BE IN ENGLISH - written in PowerPoint, in 16:9 format).
presentation.poster: Poster presentations will be performed exclusively electronically on LCD screens and therefore must be made in 16:9 ratio and resolution min. 300 dpi (.pdf format). For all accepted ABSTRACTS, the Scientific Board will make a decision.

workshopPage.title: Application for accredited professional educorkational meetings
workshopPage.intro: Dear colleagues, collaborators and dear friends,
workshopPage.p1: It is my great honor and pleasure to invite you to the planned Accredited PROFESSIONAL EDUCATIVE MEETINGS, which are part of the Congress with international participation organized by PAGNIA and ZNRM titled "Multidisciplinary approach for healthy childhood - our common care from day one"
workshopPage.p2: Each PROFESSIONAL EDUCATIVE MEETING will be separately accredited with an appropriate number of points obtained from the Medical Chamber of the Republic of North Macedonia.
workshopPage.p3: Due to limited space and the use of appropriate medical equipment during the educational meetings, please register your participation in a timely manner.
workshopPage.p4: The number of participants for one educational meeting is limited to a maximum of 30 participants, and registrations will be accepted until the approved number of participants is reached.
workshopPage.p5: The principle for registration for participation in the educational meetings is FIRST COME, FIRST SERVED.
workshopPage.p6: Based on your initially accepted application for one or more PROFESSIONAL EDUCATIVE MEETINGS, you will receive a notification from Global Net Adv that you should pay the Pro-forma Invoice for the Registration Fee for participation in the Congress and for the total number of registered educational meetings, or only for participation in the educational meetings without participating in the Congress.
workshopPage.p7: With the submission of the payment, Global Net Adv will issue you a Confirmation of your participation in the Congress and the registered professional educational meetings.
